name: flow_difficulty_scripted_leader_keeps_the_rules
description: The lobby fake's scripted leader picks the level by the PARTY difficulty op's own rules, as party.py and lobby.py do (M8, contract-m8 §3): in Ana's party, with my Ready said, her pick of the level the party already has changes nothing, clears no Ready and is answered to her alone (no PARTY_STATE to me); her Hard reaches me and clears my Ready; queued with open seats, her Very Hard is refused (the party stays at Hard and in the queue, my Ready kept, nothing sent to me), so a flow scenario cannot hold the session to a party state the real server never sends.

steps.msg: Ana's pick goes as the leader's PARTY difficulty; the party is at Normal already
the level the party has clears no Ready
and is answered to the leader alone: nothing to me
Ana's Hard reaches me and clears my Ready

steps.assert: int(seq.party['difficulty']) == 1 and seq.party['phase'] == 'queued' and Session.difficulty_id() == 'hard' and Session.state_name() == 'QUEUED'
steps.msg: queued, Ana's Very Hard is refused: the party stays at Hard and in the queue

steps.assert: Session.my_ready() and int(seq.party_states_sent.get('Sascha', 0)) == queued[0] and int(seq.party_states_sent.get('Ana', 0)) == queued[1] + 1
steps.msg: my Ready kept, nothing sent to me, the leader answered alone
